message: The other night, we had a power outage that lasted longer than I expected. I was feeling pretty proud of my stash of flashlights and power banks, even if I might have gone a tad overboard—who needs three lanterns, right? As I curled up on the couch with a book and my trusty battery-powered lantern, I realized that being ‘over-prepared’ isn’t such a bad thing after all. It turned a minor inconvenience into a cozy adventure! How do you handle power outages at home?
